overloads.semanticRole: Establishes and loads the related-many selection using the pre-modification (old) value of aField instead of its current value, then selects the first record of the resulting selection as current record.

constraints: Operates the same as RELATE MANY, except the relation is established using the old value of the one field (as returned by the Old function/command), not its current value.
Changes the selection of the related table and makes the first record of the new selection the current record.
